verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.paypal.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. /api/rest.md), and most cited docs are served as .md URLs. Dedicated agent-oriented docs (AI tools get-started, agent-tools inventory with sample prompts, MCP server, build-with-LLM) give an agent clear material to work from. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (the probe content is truncated, and there's no llms-full.txt), and independent reports of agents successfully consuming these docs.
